name: bybit-volatility-scanner
description: 24/7 Bybit volatility scanner with real-time signal detection, WebSocket updates, multi-timeframe analysis, and web dashboard

environmentVariables.SCAN_INTERVAL: Scan timing - runs at 3 seconds past each minute
environmentVariables.HISTORY_LIMIT: Number of scan results to keep in history (default: 100)
environmentVariables.BATCH_SIZE: Number of symbols to process per batch (default: 120)

features.realTimeScanning: Scans every minute at exactly 3 seconds past
features.signalDetection: Hot Now (highest z-score), Rising (positive slope), Cooling Off (big drops)
features.scanHistory: Keeps last 100 scan results with timestamps
features.dailyRestart: Automatic server restart at 00:00:03 for stability
features.memoryOptimized: Prevents memory leaks with proper cleanup
features.tradingLinks: Direct links to GoodCrypto trading pages
